title: Violin lessons from a French opera teacher
summary: He started at about 13 learning violin from a teacher from the French opera, for about three years, and took up trumpet later.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
